The '''technical support droid''', or '''tech-support droid''', was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] model utilized by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to service [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|hyperdrive docking rings]].

==Details==
Tech-support droids were small units engineered to operate in zero gravity. Operating in orbit, the droids monitored the docking procedures of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] like the [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] with [[Syliure-45 hyperdrive module/Legends|Syliure-45 hyperdrive modules]]. They also ensured the starfighter was properly secured to the ring before departure.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> The droids were fitted with yellow lights that turned green when the transport ring was correctly oriented, allowing the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] to depart.<ref name="ROTS" />

==History==
When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] departed [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] towards the end of the war, two tech-support droids helped orient his transport ring for his [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] journey.<ref name="ROTS" />
